messages:
Marta: Quick follow-up from yesterday's outage — capturing actions we agreed in the retro and clarifying runbook/playbook changes. Need owners and dates so I can update the action tracker.
Samir: Ack. I'll own the cache-warm automation and add a smoke-check step to the canary flow. Target: 1 week (2026-04-02).
Elaine: Adding suggested triage edits here. Short version to put into the runbook:
- Step 0: confirm incident type -> `rli logs query --service=inference --last=15m` (look for OOMs / evictions)
- Step 1: check cluster health -> `rli cluster status --region=us-west2`
- Step 2: if KV cache evictions > 80% then run cache warm procedure:
```
# warm cache for model alpha
rli cache warm --model=redwood-alpha-1 --prefix="/kv/prefix" --parallel=4
```
- Step 3: if recovery fails after 3 attempts, escalate to oncall and PD->eng-lead.
Elaine: Also propose we add an explicit command to rotate to fallback model variant before rolling back infra: `rli model route set --variant=alpha-quant --timeout=30s`.
Oncall Bot: NOTE: escalation matrix updated in PagerDuty. If oncall not ack in 5m, auto-escalate to eng-lead. (rule id: PD-RULE-82)
Nora: I can take the runbook doc update and the playbook checklist. Will draft and ping for review by EOD tomorrow. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-triage (draft)
DevOps: I'll add a Grafana panel for KV eviction %. Also creating a short alert: `kv_evictions_rate > 0.8 for 5m` -> warn -> `kv_evictions_rate > 0.9 for 2m` -> page.
Marta: Thanks. Concrete action list I'm recording now:
- Samir: cache-warm automation + integrate into canary (due 2026-04-02)
- Nora: runbook & playbook edits (draft by 2026-03-29)
- DevOps: Grafana panel + alert rules (due 2026-03-26)
- Elaine: triage command snippets + fallback routing step (review by 2026-03-28)
- Oncall Bot/Platform: confirm PD escalation rule config (owner: Platform Team, done) 
Samir: Quick note — for automation I'll add a dry-run mode and a rollback hook. Will post PR link once ready.
Nora: Draft pushed: https://git.redwood/internal/runbooks/patches/324 (please review inline comments). I'll highlight the new 'escalation matrix' and 'model-fallback' sections.
Elaine: One more pattern we spotted in the retro — recurring incidents spike when long-tail seq lengths > 2x baseline. Recommend adding an eval alert: `p99_seq_len > 2 * baseline_p99` -> spike alert, helpful to trigger proactive model-scaling.
Marta: Good call. Can DevOps add that as an advisory (no page) first, then escalate to page if it coincides with high CPU/evictions? 
DevOps: Yes, will implement as advisory alert first. I'll add runbook note: "if advisory fires + evictions > 75% -> follow Step 2".
Oncall Bot: Reminder: I'll post the updated escalation matrix and summary to #incidents at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Marta: Perfect. If everyone can update the PRs/alerts this week, I'll close the retro follow-ups and move owners into the monthly remediation review. :thumbsup:
Samir: On it.
Nora: Reviewing comments now.
Elaine: Reviewing automation impacts on model routing.
DevOps: Started alert PR.
Marta: Closing note — we also agreed to add a short runbook appendix with exact commands and expected outputs (copy/paste friendly). Nora, please tag me when that is in the doc so I can do a quick review before we publish.
